races.name: Sigeric Ltd Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Maximum Offers
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with highest class rating but 91 days off, benefits from Gavin Sheehan's tactical nous and Jamie Snowden's solid recent form

runners_data.name: Moonlit Potter
runners_data.note: Another prominent type with good recent form including a second 12 days ago, Luke Scott's 3lb claim useful but inexperience a concern in small field tactics

runners_data.name: Jullou De Grissay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner wearing tongue tie and cheekpieces suggesting breathing issues, Charlie Longsdon's poor recent record (0/14) is a significant negative

races.paceDynamic: Maximum Offers will likely lead or share early duties with Moonlit Potter and Jullou De Grissay all showing prominent tendencies. With only three runners, the pace should be controlled rather than frantic, allowing the leader to dictate terms through the early stages. The small field means less interference and cleaner jumping, but also fewer pace angles to exploit. This tactical setup favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently and have the class to sustain their effort, rather than pure hold-up horses who need a strong pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Maximum Offers leads and dictates steady fractions without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of class and stamina in the final half-mile, suiting the most talented horse who can quicken when asked. Maximum Offers' superior class rating and recent consistency give him the edge in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Moonlit Potter or Jullou De Grissay press Maximum Offers from the start
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates a more genuine test of stamina over the extended trip. This scenario suits horses with proven staying power and recent race fitness.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Maximum Offers Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Maximum Offers breaks clear early and faces no serious challenge
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage through superior jumping and tactical positioning. His class advantage becomes decisive when allowed to dictate terms unchallenged.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Collapse Drama
scenarios.trigger: If the leader ties up badly in the final half-mile after setting too strong a pace
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with tired horses making errors, creating opportunities for the most professional jumper. Stamina and jumping accuracy become more important than pure class.

watchPoints.text: Maximum Offers showing any signs of needing the run after his 91-day absence, particularly early in the race
Luke Scott's inexperience causing Moonlit Potter to get into the wrong position in a tactically-run small field
Jullou De Grissay's breathing equipment failing to help him see out the trip under pressure
Early jumping errors from any runner as mistakes are magnified in a three-runner field
The pace through the middle stages as it will determine whether stamina or class proves decisive

races.name: Acre Accountancy Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Geordies Betty
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with solid recent form whose style suits this tactical setup perfectly

runners_data.name: Maestro Du Mesnil
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 46-day break but has strong headgear assistance and good course record

runners_data.name: Tara Iti
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse with excellent going record but needs to bounce back from poor recent runs

runners_data.name: Churchman
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter carrying minimum weight with good recent form who could steal this if uncontested

runners_data.name: Iamyouare
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner from strong McCain yard with solid recent form and weight-for-age appeal

runners_data.name: Brave Move
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from long break but trainer O'Brien in good form and could surprise

runners_data.name: Shesupincourt
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who may track Churchman early but lacks recent winning form

runners_data.name: Chosen Bae
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with headgear assistance but needs significant improvement on recent efforts

races.paceDynamic: Churchman will set the early pace from his prominent position with only Shesupincourt likely to contest the lead early on. The pace should be sustainable rather than punishing with 6 of 8 runners being hold-up types who will settle behind the early leaders. This creates a patient, tactical affair where the front two establish a rhythm before the hold-up brigade mount their challenges in the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the lack of early pace pressure will leave plenty in reserve for those coming from behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Churchman and Shesupincourt set a steady tempo without early pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of pace allows the 6 hold-up runners to travel smoothly and unleash finishing kicks. Superior class horses like Geordies Betty, Maestro Du Mesnil and Iamyouare benefit from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front two stay there
scenarios.trigger: If Churchman gets an uncontested lead and Shesupincourt tracks him into contention
scenarios.body: The early leaders capitalize on their tactical advantage when the hold-up horses fail to quicken sufficiently. Churchman's recent good form and light weight give him the edge over his prominent rival.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class differential shows
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The higher-rated horses assert their superiority when maximum pressure is applied. Geordies Betty and Maestro Du Mesnil pull clear of their lower-grade rivals in a finish that rewards pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise package emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites disappoint or meet traffic problems
scenarios.body: One of the outsiders capitalizes on a clear passage and the tactical nature of the contest. Brave Move or Chosen Bae could benefit from the patient pace if connections have found improvement.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Churchman gets an uncontested lead as his light weight and recent form make him dangerous
Watch Maestro Du Mesnil's jumping early on his first run for 46 days despite the tongue-tie assistance
Watch for traffic problems in the straight as 6 hold-up horses will be looking for racing room simultaneously
Watch Iamyouare for market confidence given McCain's strong recent form and the horse's tactical advantage
Watch the early pace battle between Churchman and Shesupincourt to gauge how the race will unfold

runners_data.name: Gallant Lion

runners_data.name: Good For You

runners_data.name: Backer Bilk
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with OR 120 moving from flat racing, completely unexposed over hurdles but breeding suggests ability

runners_data.name: Hellion
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner who can dictate pace unopposed, key tactical advantage despite modest recent form figures

runners_data.name: Alex The Great

runners_data.name: Bowling Shane

runners_data.name: Hopjes

races.paceDynamic: Hellion is the confirmed front runner and with minimal early pace pressure from just Crystal Days likely to press, he can dictate a steady rhythm through the early stages. The lack of prominent runners means Hellion won't face sustained pressure until the field begins to close from halfway, allowing him to conserve energy for the business end. With 10+ hold-up horses including American Empire, Arctic Voyage, and Gaelic Saint all relying on finishing kicks, this creates a tactical bottleneck where positioning and room at obstacles becomes critical. This pace setup strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably unfold behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hellion Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Hellion jumps cleanly and maintains his uncontested lead without significant early pressure from Crystal Days
scenarios.body: The confirmed front runner can dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to peg back when the hold-up brigade finally launches their challenges. Crystal Days and Good For You benefit from prominent positions avoiding the traffic chaos behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Traffic Jam
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses get hampered at crucial hurdles or fail to find racing room in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The sheer volume of back markers creates a scramble where only the best-positioned or luckiest survive the melee. American Empire and Arctic Voyage have the class to navigate trouble while Gaelic Saint and Fidendum could get caught up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Crystal Days or Good For You force a genuine pace battle with Hellion from an early stage
scenarios.body: The increased tempo plays into the hands of hold-up horses who can benefit from the pace collapse up front. Gaelic Saint and Fidendum have the ratings to capitalise on a truly-run race where stamina tells.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Shot Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the main contenders encounter jumping errors or traffic problems simultaneously
scenarios.body: A lesser-fancied runner like Dinkys Rose or Bowling Shane could sneak through while the market leaders sort themselves out. These outsiders need everything to fall their way but benefit from lower expectations and potentially cleaner passages.

watchPoints.text: Hellion's jumping under pressure - any significant errors could hand the initiative to the chasing pack when they mount their challenge
Traffic problems at the final two hurdles where 10+ hold-up horses will be making their moves simultaneously in a congested finish
Crystal Days's early tactics - whether she genuinely presses Hellion or settles behind him will determine the pace dynamics
American Empire's fitness after 169-day absence - needs to prove his conditioning holds up in the closing stages
First-time hurdle runners Backer Bilk and Alex The Great - any market moves could signal yard confidence in their jumping ability

races.name: Keltruck Ltd Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Numitor
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning to handicaps after a break, but James Bowen's 0/4 record for the stable in past 14 days raises questions about stable form.

runners_data.name: Sherborne
runners_data.note: In-form prominent runner with two recent wins, wears tongue-tie and has Freddie Gingell's 7lb claim reducing him to just 146lbs.

runners_data.name: Black Hawk Eagle
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs a strong pace to be effective, returning from a 32-day break after a decent third at Cheltenham.

runners_data.name: Insurrection
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who will control this small field, but poor recent form including two falls makes him vulnerable despite tactical advantage.

runners_data.name: Coastguard Station
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing cheekpieces who needs the race to develop into a stamina test, has solid course record at Hereford.

races.paceDynamic: Insurrection will dictate proceedings from the front without serious pressure in this small field. Numitor and Sherborne are the only prominent racers, but both prefer to track rather than challenge early. This creates a perfect scenario for the Paul Nicholls-trained leader to control fractions and dictate when the race begins in earnest. The lack of pace pressure strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to Insurrection early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Insurrection Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Insurrection gets an uncontested lead and dictates moderate fractions.
scenarios.body: Harry Cobden can control the pace completely and time his effort perfectly, making it very difficult for the hold-up horses to close the gap in time. Despite recent poor form, the tactical advantage in this small field could be decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Numitor and Sherborne press forward to challenge Insurrection earlier than expected.
scenarios.body: This creates genuine pace and opens up the race for Black Hawk Eagle and Coastguard Station to close late. The increased tempo plays into the hands of horses with finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the front-runners tie up.
scenarios.body: Black Hawk Eagle and Coastguard Station benefit from a truly-run race where they can use their closing speed. Kerry Lee's charge has shown better recent form and could time his run perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate
scenarios.trigger: If all runners sit and wait behind Insurrection creating a crawling pace.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last fence where class and current form matter most. Sherborne's recent wins give him the edge in a tactical finish.

watchPoints.text: Insurrection has fallen twice in his last five starts - any jumping errors from the front could hand the race to his rivals
Watch if Numitor or Sherborne go forward early to pressure Insurrection, as this could set up the race for the hold-up horses
Black Hawk Eagle's jumping - if he travels smoothly in rear he could be perfectly positioned for a late challenge
The pace after the third-last fence will determine everything - if it's genuine both hold-up horses come alive
Sherborne carries just 146lbs with the claim and has winning momentum - dangerous if getting first run on the leaders

races.name: Robert Howell Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Court In A Storm
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with excellent recent form including two wins, benefits from tongue tie and Kim Bailey's decent strike rate

runners_data.name: Queens Venture
runners_data.note: Natural front runner returning after 131 days off but has winning form fresh and strong record on similar going

runners_data.name: I'm A Starman
runners_data.note: Prominent racer whose 13-year-old legs may struggle over this extended trip despite his experience advantage

runners_data.name: Gold For Alec
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who ran well last time but poor going record on good ground is a significant concern

runners_data.name: Grangeclare Diego
runners_data.note: Front runner with tongue tie fitted but very low TopSpeed rating suggests limited finishing kick when pressured

runners_data.name: Block Rockin Beats
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with headgear applied who won impressively at this trip but hasn't been seen for 49 days

races.paceDynamic: Queens Venture and Grangeclare Diego will contest the early lead in this small field, with both confirmed front-runners likely to engage from the start. I'm A Starman will sit prominent behind this duo, while Court In A Storm, Gold For Alec and Block Rockin Beats will settle towards the rear. The dual pace angle should create an honest gallop over this staying trip, but with only six runners the tempo may not be severe enough to fully expose the leaders. This race shape favours the hold-up horses who can benefit from the early pace battle and finish strongly up the hill.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If Queens Venture and Grangeclare Diego duel early and soften each other up
scenarios.body: The pace battle will set up the race perfectly for the closers who have less weight to carry up Hereford's stiff finish. Court In A Storm and Block Rockin Beats can time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders can establish a soft lead without serious pressure
scenarios.body: Queens Venture has the class edge and could dictate terms if Grangeclare Diego doesn't match her early, allowing her to control the tempo. The prominent I'm A Starman becomes the main danger tracking the survivor.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If I'm A Starman gets the perfect stalking position behind battling leaders
scenarios.body: The 13-year-old can use his experience to sit in the ideal spot while the front two go at it early. His prominent style means he avoids the traffic that might hinder the hold-up brigade in a small field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders compromise each other so badly they fall away completely
scenarios.body: A lack of early pace or severe early battle leaves the race wide open for any closer with a turn of foot. Block Rockin Beats could emerge from the pack if the tempo completely falls apart.

watchPoints.text: Queens Venture's market position will reveal connections' confidence after her 131-day absence from the track
Gold For Alec's poor record on good ground could see him struggle if the surface doesn't ease further
Grangeclare Diego's early tactics with Harry Cobden aboard will determine whether a genuine pace battle develops
I'm A Starman's stamina limitations at 13 years old over this extended three-mile trip need monitoring
Block Rockin Beats' jumping rhythm early on will show whether his lengthy break has affected his fluency

races.name: Burcombe Construction Ltd Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Diyaken
runners_data.note: Leading style suits but 24 days off and 8-year-old legs may not sustain effort against this quality field

runners_data.name: Red Rubio
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but trainer 0/7 in last 14 days and 36-day layoff raises fitness doubts

runners_data.name: Sun Art
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer with excellent going record (6/9 on good ground) and trainer in good form

runners_data.name: Wild Goose
runners_data.note: Class horse carrying big weight but apprentice's 10lb claim negates penalty concerns entirely

runners_data.name: Phoenix Risen
runners_data.note: Hold-up style ideal for this pace scenario but 9-year-old with patchy recent record

runners_data.name: Fight My Fire
runners_data.note: Perfect tactical profile as hold-up horse with strong recent hurdles form including last-time-out fourth

runners_data.name: The Tide Turns
runners_data.note: 161 days off makes fitness a major concern despite hold-up style suiting the race shape

runners_data.name: Grey Skies
runners_data.note: Front runner returning after 137-day break with declining 10-year-old form profile

runners_data.name: Benvoy
runners_data.note: Prominent style but inconsistent recent efforts and 41-day gap raise reliability questions

races.paceDynamic: Diyaken and Grey Skies will dispute the early lead, with Diyaken likely to assert given his fresher preparation and superior recent form. Four horses (Red Rubio, Sun Art, Wild Goose, Benvoy) want prominent positions behind them, creating congestion and potential traffic issues when the pace lifts approaching the business end. The dual pace setters should ensure an honest gallop over this sharp 2m trip, but neither looks bombproof to sustain their effort. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can bypass the early scrimmaging and deliver late challenges when the prominent pack starts to tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses profit
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine and the prominent pack gets into trouble 2-3 out
scenarios.body: The pace setters will tire and the congested prominent runners will struggle for racing room, allowing late closers to sweep past with cleaner runs. Fight My Fire and The Tide Turns are best positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tactics prevail
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses gets first run on the leaders while avoiding traffic
scenarios.body: The winner will emerge from the pack of four sitting handy, timing their move perfectly before the hold-up horses can organize their challenges. Sun Art or Wild Goose have the class to execute this.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Diyaken or Grey Skies gets easy sectionals early with the field settling behind
scenarios.body: The winner will have stolen a march with tactical speed, opening up decisive gaps when the race develops in earnest. Diyaken's recent winning form makes him the more likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy scramble finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early and turns into a sprint from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: Multiple horses will have chances in a blanket finish where positioning at the final flight proves crucial. Any horse getting a clear run can capitalize in this lottery scenario.

watchPoints.text: Wild Goose and Benvoy both carry big weights in the handicap which could tell in a strongly-run race over this sharp 2m trip
The Tide Turns hasn't run for 161 days and showed declining form before the break, making fitness a major question mark
Diyaken and Grey Skies as the pace setters - if they get easy early fractions the hold-up horses will struggle to peg them back
Traffic problems almost inevitable with Red Rubio, Sun Art, Wild Goose and Phoenix Risen all wanting similar prominent positions
Fight My Fire represents the Tizzard yard which has been among winners recently and his hold-up style perfectly suits this race shape
